descriptions.handle_event__18D16fValueSelectionP9D16f: Value selection message handler: opens on message 64 (E_FAIL if the base handler fails) and resets on 66; otherwise, when its control is ready and idle, steps the selection forward or back on two next and two previous messages (reporting an edge when read-only or disabled, else writing the navigated value to the bound kind-0/kind-1 property, highlighting it and announcing the configuration name), forwards other messages to the control and finishes in the base handler.
